svg.text: WF-019 — FENCE.I success and L1-to-LLC error recovery
Separate FENCE.I operation with L1-to-LLC error

Two separate illustrative FENCE.I operations are shown; each owner write transfers one representative 16-byte line as two 64-bit W beats, and a whole-cache scan may repeat this sequence. Success: LLC B=OKAY precedes M→E, local I-cache/fetch invalidation, and retirement; no LLC-to-DRAM write is issued. Error: B=SLVERR triggers ABORT; only after all required ABORT ACKs does cause 24 trap at the FENCE.I PC with the aligned physical line base in mtval/stval. The failed M line and directory holder are preserved; the failed fence and younger instructions do not retire, and local fetch state is not invalidated. Spacing is illustrative, not a latency contract. Signal names are logical aliases, not finalized RTL ports.
